name: Algebraic Rank Equivalent of Connectivity
description: Translates the topological requirement of a connected subgraph spanning a set of terminals into an algebraic requirement: the system of equations formed by the selected edges (each representing $x_u - x_v = 0$) on a subset $S$ must have a rank of exactly $|S| - 1$. This perfectly preserves the Steiner Tree problem while completely removing all graph terminology and forcing models to deduce that rank $|S|-1$ implies a single connected component.
